title: BFF-ADM-070 current BFF administration through actual UI

assertionSteps.title: 1. Given Admin A uses subject "admin-a" with role "FMO_ADMIN" in an isolated authenticated browser
2. And the controlled Tile fixture records the initial grid rows and persisted values
3. And Category 101 has label "category-a" and Import Map 201 has Module Name "container-a"
4. And both references belong to "FMO_ADMIN" and the Tile page category filter value is Category 101
5. And the Tile grid has record "101" owned by "FMO_ADMIN"
6. And the baseline fixture data defines "Tile Name" as "tile-070"
7. And the baseline fixture data defines "Module Path" as "/fixture"
8. And the baseline fixture data defines "Tile Path" as "/case-070"
9. And the baseline fixture data defines "Role Entities" as "E-TRADE"
10. And the baseline fixture data defines "Filter Rule" as ""
11. And the baseline Tile references use "Aplication Category" "category-a" and "Container" "container-a"
12. And Tile record "101" is inactive when this browser loads its grid
14. When Admin A clicks the button labeled "Verify" in the Tile grid row with "Record Id" "101"
15. Then the dialog titled "verify ID: 101" is visible on the Tile administration page
16. When Admin A clicks the button labeled "Verified" in dialog "verify ID: 101"
17. Then the alert with severity "error" in the portal snackbar contains the exact text "Maker and Checker should be different user."
18. And in the Tile data grid with column "Record Id", the "Verified?" cell for Tile record "101" has status tooltip "Unverified or Deactivated" on the Tile administration page
19. And the persisted-record readback for record "101" has "active" equal to false

annotations.description: Actual current React and exact-current BFF admin controllers/services/JPA with actual migration DDL in disposable PostgreSQL. Controlled OUD/EMS2 identities and local Spring bootstrap. Fixture SQL seeds/mutates isolated records; service errors are actual database errors. Undefined agreed messages remain unresolved acceptance.

limits: The recorded assertions and environment binding limit the supported business result.
